title: Accessibility: Dynamic Type Sizes
hints: Build a name → size dictionary from `allCases`, then compare with `>= .accessibility1`.
jsBridge: `DynamicTypeSize` is the user's text-size setting (`xSmall` … `accessibility5`). It's `Comparable`, so layouts can switch at a threshold. It's like responding to browser zoom or rem scaling, but it's a first-class OS setting users actually change.

compass.q: The web scales with `rem` and browser zoom. What does iOS scale, and why must layouts reflow (not just scale)?
At `accessibility3`, a horizontal row no longer fits. How do you switch to a vertical stack?
Fixed font sizes vs `.font(.body)` vs `@ScaledMetric`: which respect Dynamic Type?
How do you preview all sizes at once in Xcode (Variants, Dynamic Type preview)?
